selection_summaries_by_action.close_object_on_right: The drawer must be the right-side variant and currently open for this closing action; gripper emptiness is not causally required.
selection_summaries_by_action.look_into_object_in_front_of_object_on_l: The cup must be in front of the referenced drawer, and the drawer’s left-side position distinguishes this observation schema from the right-side variant.
selection_summaries_by_action.look_into_object_in_front_of_object_on_r: The cup must be in front of the referenced drawer, and the drawer must be the right-side one to distinguish this observation schema from the left-side variant.
selection_summaries_by_action.look_into_object_on_left: The drawer must be the left-side target and open to permit looking into its interior; an empty gripper is not required for observation.
selection_summaries_by_action.look_into_object_on_right: Looking into the drawer requires it to be open; gripper availability is unnecessary, and right-side identity does not physically enable observation.
selection_summaries_by_action.open_object_on_left: Opening requires a free gripper, a currently closed drawer, and the left-side property that distinguishes this action variant; the unanchored clearance literal is not required.
selection_summaries_by_action.open_object_on_right: Opening requires a free gripper and a currently closed drawer; the right-action variant applies to a drawer that is not on the left. The dependent clearance literal is not universally applicable and is omitted.
selection_summaries_by_action.pick_up_object_in_front_of_object_on_lef: Picking up requires a free gripper and the cup to be at the stated source relation; the drawer's left-side property distinguishes this schema from the right-side variant.
selection_summaries_by_action.pick_up_object_in_front_of_object_on_rig: Picking up requires a free gripper and the cup to be in front of the referenced drawer; the drawer's non-left position distinguishes the right-side action variant.
selection_summaries_by_action.pick_up_object_in_object_on_left: Picking up the block requires a free gripper, the block to be inside the referenced drawer, the drawer to be the left-side variant, and the drawer to be open for access.
selection_summaries_by_action.pick_up_object_in_object_on_right: The gripper must be free, the block must be inside the referenced drawer, the drawer must be the right-side variant, and it must be open to access the block.
selection_summaries_by_action.place_object_into_object_on_left: The block must be held, and the destination must be the left drawer and open for insertion. Other candidates are redundant gripper state or nonessential absence relations.
selection_summaries_by_action.place_object_into_object_on_right: The block must be held, and the destination must be the open right-side drawer. Other negatives are redundant or merely describe the placement result before execution.

  ;; place the {param_1} on the top of the {param_2} on the right
  (:action place_object_on_top_of_object_on_right
    :parameters (?arg0 - cup ?arg1 - drawer)
    :precondition
      (and
        (gripper_holding ?arg0)
        (not (on_left ?arg1))
        (not (open ?arg1))
        (forall (?dep0_0 - movable_item)
          (and
            (not (on_top_of ?dep0_0 ?arg1))
          )
        )
      )
    :effect
      (probabilistic
        ; fixed: add=['gripper_empty()', 'on_top_of(?arg0,?arg1)'], del=['gripper_holding(?arg0)']
        ; bucket: place_object_on_top_of_object_on_right_success, success: true, variant_rank: 0
        1.000000 (and (gripper_empty) (on_top_of ?arg0 ?arg1) (not (gripper_holding ?arg0)))
      )
  )

  ;; push the {param_1} on the {param_2} on the right to the {param_3} on the left
  (:action push_object_on_object_on_right_to_object_on_left
    :parameters (?arg0 - box ?arg1 - drawer ?arg2 - drawer)
    :precondition
      (and
        (gripper_empty)
        (not (on_left ?arg1))
        (not (open ?arg1))
        (not (open ?arg2))
        (on_left ?arg2)
        (on_top_of ?arg0 ?arg1)
      )
    :effect
      (probabilistic
        ; fixed: add=['on_top_of(?arg0,?arg2)'], del=['on_top_of(?arg0,?arg1)']
        ; bucket: push_object_on_object_on_right_to_object_on_left_success, success: true, variant_rank: 0
        1.000000 (and (on_top_of ?arg0 ?arg2) (not (on_top_of ?arg0 ?arg1)))
      )
  )

  ;; Observation-action learning is not implemented yet.
)
